capabilities: Draw mind maps from indented outline code blocks
Render a note's headings and lists as a side-panel mind map
Edit nodes on the chart with keyboard shortcuts and a right-click menu
Switch between four layouts and 17 themes
Export a note's charts to one self-contained HTML page
disambiguation: Not an outliner or outline editor; it draws existing outlines as mind maps and flowcharts.
extras: Node positions are saved as one JSON file per note in a configurable vault folder; nothing is sent over the network. Charts in code blocks are view-only on touch screens. Interface is English or Chinese following Obsidian's language. Licensed GPL-3.0.
problem: Outlines in notes are plain indented text, so their structure cannot be seen or rearranged as a diagram.

relations.evidence: The syntax is compatible with Flowchart Fun and adds loops, summary braces and notes under nodes.

summary: Draws indented outlines and note headings as editable mind maps and flowcharts, with four layouts, 17 themes, drag-and-snap positioning and HTML export.
